thread:
lumenpay-support: Hey @maria, we're seeing a regression in our payouts assistant after the 08:30 rollout this morning. Replies are missing citations and sometimes hallucinating invoice amounts. Example below — used to return doc refs, now just a paragraph.

lumenpay-support: Original (pre-rollout):
```
User: "Which doc backs the fee schedule for ACH payouts?"
Assistant: "See Invoice Guide v2 (doc_47) — section 3.2. Fee schedule is $0.25 per transaction. [citation: doc_47#sec3.2]"
```

lumenpay-support: After rollout (post-rollout):
```
Assistant: "The fee depends on your bank and plan, typically a small fixed fee per transaction."
```

lumenpay-support: We haven't changed our prompts. We pass model=redwood-gen-4 and reranker=enabled, top_k=5. Request id for a failing call: req_2026_09_12_0814.

maria-cs: Thanks — can you paste the API call (headers sanitized) and the model+reranker versions? Also any retrieval logs if available?

lumenpay-support: Sure. Curl (sensitive keys redacted):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-4","prompt":"Which doc backs the fee schedule for ACH payouts?","tools":{"retrieval":{"top_k":5,"reranker":"rk-1.3.0"}}}'
```

lumenpay-support: Retrieval log for req_2026_09_12_0814 (trimmed):
```
QUERY: "fee schedule ACH payouts"
EMBED_MODEL: embed-2
TOP_K: 5
RETRIEVED: doc_12 (score 0.57), doc_47 (score 0.54), doc_99 (score 0.21)
RERANKER: rk-1.3.0 -> reranked order: doc_12, doc_99, doc_47
GENERATED: no citations, generic text
```

lumenpay-support: Note: doc_47 used to be first after rerank pre-rollout. Something changed in reranker ordering.

devon-ml: @sam-eng can you confirm whether we rolled a new reranker binary or changed reranker weights in the 08:30 deploy? Also did the embedding model change?

sam-eng: Ops bot shows deployment: deploy-2026-09-12-hash: abcd1234 at 08:29:58. Change log: "reranker: promote rk-1.3.0; default_alpha: 0.25 -> 0.15; optimized scoring path". No embedding model change.

ops-bot: [deploy] service=inference-router env=prod sha=abcd1234 started at 2026-09-12T08:29:58Z by @release-bot.

devon-ml: That alpha change could reduce weight on BM25/lexical signals & favor semantic similarity — may cause doc_47 (which has high lexical overlap) to drop. Can you reproduce locally with reranker_alpha=0.25 vs 0.15?

lumenpay-support: Reproduced quickly by setting reranker_alpha=0.25 -> doc_47 returns first with citation. With 0.15 -> doc_12 surfaces and no citation.

maria-cs: Good repro. For customer-facing mitigation, can we pin LumenPay to old reranker config or rollback rk-1.3.0? They need citations for compliance audits.

devon-ml: Short-term options: 1) pin customer to reranker_alpha=0.25 or rk-1.2.x (we still have older weights), 2) increase top_k and force citation post-processing that matches titles to docs, 3) rollback global alpha change if multiple customers impacted. I'll run a batch compare on recall@3 for a seeded prompt set.

lumenpay-support: Pinning to rk-1.2.9 fixed outputs in our smoke tests. Can you enable that flag for the LumenPay org id until you have a permanent fix?

sam-eng: I'll enqueue a config override for org:lumenpay -> reranker_version:rk-1.2.9 and alpha:0.25. ETA 30m.

maria-cs: I've opened ticket CS-7341 and notified LumenPay. Workarounds and repro steps are in the ticket. Please add regression metrics and a plan to prevent future silent quality shifts. :pray:

devon-ml: Action items: (a) run recall/precision for seeded prompts pre/post deploy, (b) audit reranker alpha change across customers, (c) instrument per-org rerank diagnostics, (d) consider gradual rollout with quality checks. I'll post results in this thread.

lumenpay-support: Thanks all — customer confirms pinned config restores compliance outputs. Please keep us posted on root cause and timeline for a safe restore.

sam-eng: noted. I'll update ticket once override is live. :white_check_mark:
